need_profile: Automated weekday run queries Coupa for draft/new invoices from the past seven days, excludes credit notes, counts those with no properly linked PO, and sends one Block Kit Slack message to the AP SME; sends nothing on a clean day; Weekday schedule at 10:00 ...
